title: The Late Garden
author: Tamsin Almeida
blurb: Lior Fairweather, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
